description: Open 30 real-time alert tabs in Microsoft Edge and use Microsoft AI (Copilot + Bing) to summarize, prioritize, and surface important changes

aiWorkflow.onTabOpen: Ask Copilot to summarize the page in 3 bullet points
aiWorkflow.continuousMonitoring: Every 5 minutes ask Copilot: 'Any critical updates or alerts on this page?'
aiWorkflow.priorityAlert: If Copilot detects keywords like emergency, outbreak, crash, fire, death, market crash → notify user
aiWorkflow.dailyDigest: At end of day generate one combined AI summary of all 30 tabs
